text: Shows pull-request runs (build and unit tests, never deploy) separately from merge-to-main runs, which run the full pipeline.
Builds the image once per run, tagged with the commit SHA, and deploys that same image to staging and production with no rebuild.
Runs unit and integration tests in parallel. Integration tests are retried once and unit tests are not. Any test failure ends the run before staging.
Deploys staging with deploy.sh staging, runs smoke tests, and on smoke failure runs deploy.sh rollback staging and ends the run.
Has a manual approval gate limited to release-approvers, excluding the commit author, with a 72-hour expiry after which nothing goes to production.
Starts production only inside the Mon-Thu 09:00-15:00 UTC window, with at most one production deploy in progress at a time.

Runs a canary in production with deploy.sh canary and watches it for 15 minutes. A 5xx rate above 1% leads to canary-off and a failed run. Otherwise deploy.sh production runs, then the canary is removed.
Is delivered as a Mermaid flowchart with short notes, showing failure paths and the #deploys announcements for failures, expiries and finished production deploys.
